reason: Returning-candidate row 'DrupalCamp NJ 2026' (Princeton, Mar 12 2026). The camp has renamed itself: drupalcampnj.org now redirects to webcampnj.org, whose event page (https://www.webcampnj.org/events/webcamp-nj-2027) reads 'WebCamp NJ 2027, Thursday, March 11 - Friday, March 12, 2027 ... WebCamp NJ is the evolution of DrupalCamp New Jersey, an annual, volunteer-organized, web development conference held since 2012'. The directions page (https://www.webcampnj.org/directions-and-parking) says 'The 2027 camp will be held on March 11-12 in McDonnell & Jadwin Halls at Princeton University'; sessions are 'live and in-person'. Early-bird registration opened Nov 2 2026. Not in data/events.json under either name.

record.name: WebCamp NJ
record.audience: web developers, Drupal and open-source practitioners, site builders
record.description: Volunteer-run two-day web development conference in Princeton, formerly DrupalCamp New Jersey (held since 2012): summits and trainings on day one, a keynote and about 25 sessions on day two.
